Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Exoplan's paywall toggle - flipping the "Free trial" switch swaps the price (₹999/month to ₹499 with a strikethrough original) and the main CTA's label ("Upgrade" to "Start 3-day free trial") with a vertical slide-and-fade text animation over the app's aurora gradient.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark paywall: "Upgrade to exoplan PRO" header with PRO pill, tagline, feature list (Magic Planner, Auto-Reschedule, Plan My Day) with check icons, and a green-amber aurora glow rising from the bottom. Bottom stack: a "Free trial" row with a switch, the price line, a wide dark CTA button, and small Restore/Terms links.

## Motion spec
Pattern: toggle-driven state swap with rolling text.
- Toggle: the switch knob slides and tints on (spring ~400/22, 200ms).
- Price swap: the current price slides up and fades out while the new price slides in from below (250ms, ease-out); the strikethrough original fades in beside the trial price (150ms delay).
- CTA label: the button's text rolls vertically - old label exits upward, new label enters from below (250ms, ease-in-out) inside a clipped label container; button size stays fixed.
- Aurora: the bottom glow brightens subtly when the trial is on (300ms).

## Calibration
- Price and CTA change together in one choreographed beat - never one without the other.
- Keep the roll direction consistent (always upward) on both toggle directions.

## Reduced motion
Price and label cross-fade (150ms) without the vertical roll.

## Don't miss
- The trial state shows the discounted price with the original struck through - both numbers visible.
- The CTA never resizes; only its label animates.
